name: Trespass Offering
overview: The Trespass Offering, as detailed in Leviticus 5:1-6, addresses sins committed in ignorance, such as failing to report wrongdoing, touching unclean things unknowingly, or rashly swearing. Scripture requires confession and the bringing of a female from the flock—a lamb or a kid—as a sin offering, through which the priest makes atonement. This offering underscores the seriousness of unintentional sins and the necessity of restitution and purification, highlighting God's provision for cleansing even those offenses committed without full knowledge.
